req.title: Player creation persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall commit newly created players to the players table so subsequent GET requests return them.

doc.reasoning: To ensure the player creation endpoint correctly persists new players to the database, we need to test various scenarios: a successful creation, a failure due to a duplicate squad number, and boundary conditions around squad number validation.

tests.name: test_create_player_success
preconditions: The database is empty or does not contain a player with squad number 10.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with valid player data.
expected: The response contains the correct player data with a generated UUID.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Team A",
    "league": "League 1",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert response_data["firstName"] == "John"
assert response_data["squadNumber"] == 10
assert "id" in response_data

tests.name: test_create_player_duplicate_squad_number
preconditions: A player with squad number 10 already exists in the database.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with player data having the same squad number.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating a conflict.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Ensure a player with squad number 10 exists
existing_player_data = {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Smith",
    "dateOfBirth": "1992-02-02",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Team B",
    "league": "League 2",
    "starting11": False
}
client.post("/players/", json=existing_player_data)

# Test action
new_player_data = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Team A",
    "league": "League 1",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=new_player_data)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert response.json()["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."
